correctness.rationale: Differentiated cubic Lagrange interpolation gives the two-difference recurrence exactly. Its full three-period monodromy has rational trace U/P and determinant V/P, with P>0. Explicit identities show P-U+V=6Xs^4q2, P+U+V=XHplus and P-V=XHdet, with all displayed factors and monomial coefficients strictly positive for x,y,z>0. The real quadratic Schur criterion then proves both parasitic eigenvalues strictly unit-disk, without inference from samples. Exact rational limits for (t,1,t^-1) give trace=-1+16/(3t)+O(t^-2) and determinant=1/(3t^3)+O(t^-4), hence sharp spectral-radius supremum 1. The packaged checker reconstructs and verifies these identities and 1,200 independent samples; classical fixed-pattern zero-stability follows by summation of geometrically decaying differences.

value.rationale: This is a complete two-parameter classification of the parasitic stability of a natural repeating nonuniform mesh, with arbitrary adjacent jumps beyond commonly cited fixed ratio limits. It gives an exact Schur certificate and determines a physically relevant limit in which strong zero stability persists for each pattern while the damping margin tends to zero as 16/(3t). This structural contrast is not entailed by arbitrary-grid ratio-restricted theorems or a finite census. The statement carefully limits itself to fixed-pattern homogeneous zero stability rather than general nonlinear or adaptive-grid robustness.
